_DrawTextureAspect.desc: Draws the texture centered in the given box preserving its aspect ratio (coordinates rounded, internal).

_DrawTiledTexture.desc: Draws a stretchable texture nine-patch style: corners keep their size, edges and center stretch by texture coordinates, and corner sizes shrink when space is tight.

_DrawTiledBorder.desc: Draws a texture border nine-patch style; unlike _DrawTiledTexture the center area is not filled.

DrawWindow.desc: Draws a window: tiles TileImage as the background using color, then prints the caption with the centered font.

DrawButton.desc: Draws the button's BK/FG tile layers, recoloring for the pressed/hovered state, then prints the caption centered or per align.

DrawComboBox.desc: Calls DrawButton for the body, then draws the drop-down arrow at the right, aspect-fit inside padding width.

params.self: combobox control (which also acts as a button).

DrawEditBox.desc: Draws the edit box background and border, the text (hint, password mask, overflow clipping), the blinking cursor and the selection highlight.

DrawPanel.desc: Draws the panel background as two tiled layers, TileImageBK (backgroundColor) and TileImageFG (borderColor).

DrawItemBkGnd.desc: Tiles the BK/FG item background images, choosing colors according to state.

params.state: Item state; 'selected' uses the selected colors.

DrawScrollPanelBorder.desc: Draws the scroll panel border with _DrawTiledBorder, reducing the size by the visible scrollbars.

DrawScrollPanel.desc: Draws the scroll panel background tiles plus the vertical/horizontal scrollbar tracks and the knobs positioned from scrollPos.

DrawCheckbox.desc: Draws the checkbox box (optionally the round image, honoring boxalign) and the check mark, then prints the caption.

DrawProgressbar.desc: Draws the background and the filled bar computed from value/min/max (supports fillPadding, vertical orientation and caption).

DrawTrackbar.desc: Draws the trackbar rail, the step tick marks at the step interval, and the thumb positioned by _GetPercent().

DrawTreeviewNode.desc: When the node is the treeview's selected item, tiles ImageNodeSelected as its selection background.

DrawTreeviewNodeTree.desc: Draws the node's hierarchy connector lines (_DrawLineV + _DrawLineH) and, if it has children, the expanded/collapsed icon.

DrawLine.desc: Draws a 4-pixel tiled line, vertical or horizontal depending on whether style starts with 'v'.

DrawTabBarItem.desc: Draws a tab's background and border with colors chosen from the pressed/hovered/selected state, then centers the caption via DrawInBox.

DrawDragGrip.desc: Draws the gray/dark drag-grip arrow triangle at the window's top-left corner using TRIANGLES.

DrawResizeGrip.desc: When obj.resizable is true, draws three diagonal lines as the resize handle inside boxes.resize using LINES.

_ProcessRelative.desc: Converts a relative coordinate code to pixels: 'NN%' is a percentage of the total clamped to 0-100, and negative values count from the end.

params.code: Relative coordinate code: percentage string or number.

GetRelativeObjBox.desc: Resolves the {x,y,w,h} relative box against obj.width/height via _ProcessRelative into an absolute pixel box.
GetRelativeObjBox.returns: Absolute pixel box {left, top, right, bottom}.

NCHitTestWithPadding.desc: Non-client hit test: after insetting by hitpadding, checks the resize/drag boxes and the draggable/click-through area; returns obj on a hit.
NCHitTestWithPadding.returns: obj on a hit, otherwise false/nil (internal).

WindowNCMouseDown.desc: Non-client mouse down: calls StartResizing inside the resize box and StartDragging inside the drag box.

WindowNCMouseDownPostChildren.desc: Runs when the children did not consume the press: StartDragging if draggable without a grip, otherwise returns obj for noClickThrough.

module.summary: Skin drawing helpers: per-control GL draw functions, tiled nine-patch and border drawing, non-client hit testing, and relative-coordinate (right/bottom/percent) conversion.

fileDesc: Skin drawing toolkit: GL draw functions for each control, nine-patch tiled and border drawing, non-client hit testing and relative-coordinate helpers.
